name: Blood Shards of Agamaggan
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Along with the thorns, the blood affected <snort> other aspects of the earth: blood red stones mixed in with other minerals. The Bristleback dig up these shards and carry them as totems <snort> for strength in battle and as totems for their magics. <snort>

I know the secrets of that magic.

Bring Mangletooth one of these blood shards to show you understand. Bring Mangletooth many of the shards, and he will bless you with quilboar magic--the magic of Agamaggan! <snort>
narrative.objectives:
Bring a Blood Shard to Mangletooth in Camp Taurajo in the Barrens.

Collect more Blood Shards if you want him to bless you with Agamaggan's power.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Ah, you do understand. <snort> My words were not lost on your ears, friend. Mangletooth may be caged, but no cage can stop Agamaggan's power! <snort>

The touch of the shard, the feel of it... it has been a long time, friend.

Do you know what it is like? To have your power severed from you?

But, that is a tale for another time. I promised you information. I promised you Agamaggan's power. My people turned their backs on Mangletooth. Now, I lose you upon them. <snort>
narrative.requestItemsText:
Our tribes flock to the thorny areas throughout the Barrens <snort> because they are holy places, but none as holy as Razorfen. Agamaggan's body makes up the entirety of the Razorfen, <snort> but the Downs are especially protected because the entrance is made from his great maw! <snort> It will swallow whole those not loyal to him, and spit out their bodies after he's chewed them up! <snort>

Agamaggan has left his body behind to protect us, and he gives of his spirit so we may protect him. <snort>

chain.subtitle: 10 quests from level 20 to 25, 7,450 XP in all.

quests.name: Tribes at War
quests.objectiveText: Kill 6 Bristleback Water Seekers, 12 Bristleback Thornweavers and 12 Bristleback Geomancers and return to Mangletooth at Camp Taurajo in the Barrens.

quests.name: Blood Shards of Agamaggan
quests.objectiveText: Bring a Blood Shard to Mangletooth in Camp Taurajo in the Barrens. Collect more Blood Shards if you want him to bless you with Agamaggan's power.

quests.name: Betrayal from Within
quests.objectiveText: Kill Nak, Kuz, and Lok Orcbane and bring their skulls to Mangletooth at Camp Taurajo in the Barrens.

quests.name: Betrayal from Within
quests.objectiveText: Bring Lok's Skull to Thork at the Crossroads in the Barrens.
